kind: bug / Graph / Python builtin / internal compiler error
title: Graph mode crashes with an internal seq_abs null pointer for filter/comprehension predicates returning scalar Tensor bool
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 static graph syntax documentation lists filter as a supported Python built-in and describes its use as similar to Python.
Python filter accepts an iterable and keeps elements for which the predicate is true.

Graph mode supports the same Tensor scalar bool predicate in an equivalent if statement. filter(lambda row: True, ...) passes for both Tensor and tuple inputs, and unfiltered list/generator comprehensions over Tensor rows also pass.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: the failure is a Graph internal compiler error.
Not a CPU kernel issue: the error occurs during Graph transformation/compilation.
Distinct from MS-021: filter with a Python-bool predicate works over Tensor; the failing axis is sequence filtering whose predicate returns a scalar Tensor bool.
The error message is internal ('pointer[seq_abs] is null'), so even if some filter predicate forms are unsupported, this should not surface as a null-pointer compiler failure.
